message.reasoning:
This is a huge class (StringUtils from Apache Commons Lang), so I need to write a JUnit 4 test suite with good branch coverage. Given its size, I'll focus on the most important methods with clear branch logic rather than testing everything exhaustively.

I'm planning test cases grouped by category: empty/blank checks, trim/strip variants, equals comparisons, various indexOf/lastIndexOf overloads, contains checks, substring operations, and left/right/mid extraction methods, making sure to cover null, empty string, and boundary conditions for each.

Continuing to map out more test groups: substringBetween variants, the many split overloads, join methods, whitespace removal, remove/replace operations in their various forms, replaceChars, overlay, chomp, chop, repeat, and padding methods -- planning to hit boundary and null cases for each.

Still cataloguing more: length, center, case conversion with locale, capitalize/swapCase, countMatches, the various isAlpha/isNumeric/isWhitespace character checks, defaultString, reverse, abbreviate, difference/Levenshtein distance, and startsWith/endsWith variants. With this many methods, I'm realizing the test suite needs to be quite extensive to cover them all properly.

I plan to write concise but thorough test methods, relying mostly on assertEquals/assertTrue/assertFalse/assertNull patterns drawn from the javadoc examples, since those examples effectively serve as the spec. I also note that ArrayUtils, ObjectUtils, and CharUtils are referenced by this class but aren't themselves...

Since this is Defects4J Lang-40b, part of the full Apache Commons Lang library, I'll assume those supporting classes exist on the classpath within the same package. I'm aiming for a comprehensive test case covering nearly every method, while trimming redundancy where possible.
